To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
tourism core-competences can be developed by the local tourism firms in a networked way.
tourism firms in an area characterized by a low tourism economy can build up tourism core-competences through the development of a network of relationships among local firms and institutions.

(1) the development of core-competencies is a dynamic process which can be fostered by the creation of a networked system among tourism firms; (2) the development of tourism networked systems can be fostered through the implementation of a policy aimed at supporting the creation of local tourism clusters; (3) the creation of local tourist clusters requires a policy aimed at fostering the development of tourism resources and the development of local tourism competencies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following question: what are the main drivers and barriers of tourism core- competence development?
the relationship between tourism core-competency development and the local resources of the territory and the network of relationships between tourism firms.
a theoretical and empirical study about the determinants of the development of tourism excellence in a local system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a network-based approach to the development of tourism local systems is a key element to foster the development of tourism competencies, which is a crucial factor for the competitiveness of tourism destinations.
a tourism system can be considered a network of firms that are able to create value from the resources and competencies available.
the tourism core-competency development in a given area is the result of a set of factors that are both internal to the area and external to the area.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the development of tourism networks and tourism core-competences are complementary in terms of their contribution to the tourism system development.
tourism core competencies are developed by the local actors in a context where tourism firms are able to create and manage networked relationships with the other actors of the tourism system.
the development of tourism resources is not sufficient for a successful tourism development.
The main takeaway from our work is that
tourism core-competences are the result of a dynamic process of resource-based local development.
tourism core-competences are the result of an interaction between the development of local resources and the networking approach of firms.
tourism core-competences are the key factor to enhance tourism excellence in local systems.
